options.label: Revoke the whole family on reuse
options.pros: Matches R1 and the owner's brief M1.
options.cons: A user with two tabs racing a refresh is logged out.

recommendation.text: Revoke the family. R1 is a must requirement and decision D1 already chose strict rotation; the race is handled in P2.2 by a single-flight refresh in the web client.

rationale: The requirement text and the recorded decision settle the question; the trade-off is already assigned to another item.
assumptions: P2.2 implements single-flight refresh as planned.
